newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP 9 mo copper concentrate up 40 pc.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP 9 mo copper concentrate up 40 pc.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Tuesday its production of copper concentrate for the nine months to February 28 rose 40 percent to 541,000 tonnes, compared to the corresponding period a year ago.
Production of copper cathode totalled 308,200 tonnes over the nine months, the company said.
There was no comparable figure for the corresponding period last year for anode production.
Copper concentrate output in February totalled 57,100 tonnes, up eight percent over February 1996, despite a lower contribution from the Chilean operations, BHP said.

On a year-to-date basis, concentrate output in Chile, where BHP holds a 57.5 percent stake in the La Escondida mine, was higher in the latest nine-month period but lower in February, owing to reduced plant and pipeline availability, it said.
BHP's share of output from Escondida totalled 338,400 tonnes in the latest nine months, up from 219,400 a year earlier.
Copper anode production in Chile was 24,700 tonnes in the nine months against 14,800 tonnes a year earlier, BHP said.

Copper concentrate output from the wholly-owned San Manuel mine in the United States rose to 64,300 tonnes in the nine months from 13,700 a year earlier while San Manuel cathode output jumped to 16,200 tonnes from 3,600 tonnes a year earlier.
Production of concentrates from the Ok Tedi copper mine in Papua New Guinea was higher in February, reflecting milling of richer ore grades during the month, BHP said.
Shipments also were up from PNG in February when compared to the February 1996, when the mine faced shipping delays, it said.
BHP copper production ('000 tonnes unless otherwise stated)
NOTE: February is the ninth month of BHP's financial year.
